title: Crossfade
description: Input a fades out while input b fades in over the same stretch, in bars or seconds. Equal power by default.

parameters.name: start
parameters.doc: Where the crossfade starts: a bar position (1 is the first bar, 5.5 is half way through bar 5) or seconds from the beginning of the song (12s).

parameters.name: length
parameters.doc: How long it takes: bars (2, 0.5) or seconds (1.5s).

parameters.name: shape
parameters.doc: equal: equal power, the loudness stays the same for two unrelated sounds. lin: a straight line in volume (right for the same sound twice). exp: starts slowly and ends fast.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
